features.title: What the Cutting Assistant does
features.subtitle: Six powerful AI capabilities — seamlessly integrated into your TRUMPF machine.

items.title: Auto Parameter Optimization
items.desc: Analyzes material type, thickness, and cutting geometry to automatically select optimal laser power, speed, and gas pressure. Setup time reduced from 30 minutes to under 2 minutes.

items.title: Adaptive Cutting
items.desc: Real-time sensor feedback continuously adjusts cutting parameters mid-job to compensate for material variations, thermal effects, and workpiece deformation.

items.title: Collision Avoidance
items.desc: AI-powered path planning prevents costly nozzle collisions with cut-out parts, dramatically reducing unplanned machine stops and part damage.

items.title: Material Detection
items.desc: Camera and sensor fusion identifies material type and surface condition before cutting, automatically confirming the correct parameter set.

items.title: Oseon Integration
items.desc: Seamless data exchange with TRUMPF's Oseon manufacturing execution software for job scheduling, full traceability, and production reporting.

items.title: One-Click Job Setup
items.desc: Import a new cutting job and the assistant handles the rest — parameter selection, nesting optimization, and pre-run checks. Ready in seconds.

integration.title: Seamlessly integrated into your TRUMPF ecosystem.
integration.subtitle: The Cutting Assistant connects natively with TRUMPF's software suite and your existing production environment.

operator.q: How long does it take to train the system on our materials?
operator.a: The Cutting Assistant works from the first job using TRUMPF's global parameter database. It then learns from your specific material batches over time. Most operators report full confidence within the first week.

operator.q: Can it handle all materials and thicknesses?
operator.a: Yes — the system supports all standard sheet metals (mild steel, stainless, aluminum, copper, brass) across the full thickness range of your TRUMPF machine. Exotic alloys can be added via custom material profiles.

operator.q: What happens if the AI recommends wrong parameters?
operator.a: You always have final approval before a cut starts. The system shows its confidence level and lets you override any parameter. If you override, the assistant learns from your correction and improves future recommendations.

operator.q: Does it work with our existing cutting programs?
operator.a: Yes. The Cutting Assistant works with programs created in TruTops Boost and all standard DXF/DWG formats. No reprogramming required.

operator.q: What happens during a network outage?
operator.a: All core functions run locally on the machine controller. A network connection is only required for Oseon integration and cloud-based parameter updates.

management.q: What is the typical implementation timeline?
management.a: Standard deployment takes 2–4 weeks including machine integration, operator training, and system validation. Enterprise deployments with complex MES integration typically take 6–8 weeks.

management.q: What does the license model look like?
management.a: The Cutting Assistant is available as a per-machine annual subscription or as a one-time license with optional support contract. Volume pricing is available for multi-machine deployments. Contact TRUMPF sales for a detailed quote.

management.q: How does it integrate with our existing MES or ERP?
management.a: The Cutting Assistant integrates natively with TRUMPF Oseon. For third-party MES/ERP systems, data exchange is handled via OPC UA, REST API, or standard file-based interfaces. TRUMPF's integration team supports the setup.

management.q: What level of IT infrastructure is required?
management.a: The software runs on the TRUMPF machine controller — no separate server hardware is required for core functions. Oseon integration requires network connectivity. Cloud features require internet access but operate on a secure, isolated channel.

management.q: What is included in the support package?
management.a: Standard support includes software updates, parameter database updates, and remote diagnostics. Premium support adds dedicated application engineering and on-site response SLAs.
